def: to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger)

occurrences.text: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
